column1: What is IUEA known for?
column2: IUEA is known for its diverse and inclusive community that celebrates cultural diversity. With modern facilities and experienced faculty, IUEA offers a world-class education that prepares students for the global job market. At IUEA, we empower students to be job creators rather than job seekers. The university provides innovative curricula in engineering, business, IT, law, and humanities with a strong focus on employability to ensure student success. Additionally, IUEA offers a vibrant campus life and various extracurricular activities that promote holistic development. Join IUEA to be part of a community that nurtures your potential and prepares you for a successful future.

column1: Why choose IUEA?
column2: IUEA is a private Chartered University with an exciting multicultural learning environment, a proven ability to greatly enhance student career prospects. column1: SUB-CATEGORY: LANGUAGE COURSES
What language courses are available at IUEA?
column2:
IUEA offers certificate courses in both English and French. The English course has three levels: Beginner, Elementary, and Intermediate. It costs 100 USD per level and lasts for two months. Before enrolling, students are required to take an English placement test, which helps determine the appropriate starting level. Registration for the English course can be completed at the university between 8:00 a.m. and 5:00 p.m., Monday to Friday, and an application fee of 15,000 Ugandan Shillings (UGX) is required.

The French language course at IUEA consists of four levels. Each level costs 200,000 UGX, and there is a registration fee of 50,000 UGX. Students can attend classes from Monday to Friday between 2:00 p.m. and 4:00 p.m. or 5:30 p.m. and 7:30 p.m. Weekend classes are available as well, with sessions on Saturday from 10:00 a.m. to 1:00 p.m. and on Sunday from 3:00 p.m. to 6:00 p.m. To register for the French course, students should contact +256 784 079781 or +256 777 426886.

column1: Does IUEA have an English Language course?
column2: The English language course at IUEA is designed with three levels: Beginner, Elementary, and Intermediate. Students are required to take an English test to assess their current proficiency, and based on the results, they will be placed at the appropriate level. Each level costs 100 USD and the course duration is two months. To register, students must visit the university in person between 8:00 a.m. and 5:00 p.m., Monday to Friday. There is an application fee of 15,000 Ugandan Shillings (UGX) that must be paid at the time of registration.

column1: Does IUEA have a French Language course?
column2: The French language course at IUEA is structured into four levels. Each level costs 200,000 Ugandan Shillings (UGX), and a separate registration fee of 50,000 UGX must be paid. Students have flexible scheduling options, with weekday classes available from 2:00 p.m. to 4:00 p.m. or from 5:30 p.m. to 7:30 p.m. Weekend classes are also available, running from 10:00 a.m. to 1:00 p.m. on Saturdays and from 3:00 p.m. to 6:00 p.m. on Sundays. To apply for the French course, students should contact +256 784 079781 or +256 777 426886.

column2: Yes, our online courses are 100% online. This includes assessments and examinations.

column1: Can I switch to the online mode of study if I have been studying on campus?
column2: Students enrolled in online programs cannot switch to on-campus study, and vice versa. However, if an on-campus student finds themselves unable to continue attending classes, we recommend getting guidance and support regarding the possibility of a study break with their faculty.

column1: Can a student transferring from another university continue their current programme online at IUEA?

column1: Can a student transferring from another university continue their current programme on-campus at IUEA?
column2: Yes. Transfer students can continue their studies on-campus at IUEA without having to start from year 1, semester 1.

column1: Do you have online study programmes?
column2: Yes, IUEA is accredited by the National Council for Higher Education to conduct online classes.

column1: SUB-CATEGORY: ACADEMIC ENTRY REQUIREMENTS
What is the A-Level grading system in Uganda and what are principal passes?
column2: In Uganda, the Uganda Advanced Certificate of Education (UACE)  commonly known as A-Level  is assessed by the Uganda National Examinations Board (UNEB). Students typically take 3 principal subjects and sometimes subsidiary subjects like General Paper or Subsidiary Mathematics. Each principal subject is graded as follows: A (Excellent) = 6 points. B (Very Good) = 5 points. C (Good) = 4 points. D (Fair) = 3 points. E (Satisfactory) = 2 points. O (Subsidary Pass) = 1 point. F (Fail) = 0 points. A principal pass is any grade from A to E. Grades O and F are not considered principal passes. To qualify for university admission under most programs, students are generally required to have at least two principal passes, though competitive programs may require three. Subsidiary subjects like General Paper or Subsidiary Mathematics are graded out of 1 point and do not count as principal passes, but they can influence overall points for admission or weighting in selection processes.

column1: What are the academic requirements to apply for a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering
column2:
Applicants must have at least two Principal Passes in Physics and Mathematics at UACE or an equivalent qualification.
Alternatively, applicants may qualify if they hold a diploma from a recognised institution in a relevant field such as Civil Engineering, Water & Sanitation Engineering, Architecture, or other related areas. Diplomas in Science Technology (Physics or Chemistry), Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Ceramics, Refrigeration & Air Conditioning, or Electrical Engineering are also acceptable. Additionally, applicants with a bachelor's degree in the Physical Sciences may be considered.

Students without "A Levels" must complete a Foundation or Higher Education program. International Baccalaureate students need a minimum of 26 points. If you already have a Bachelor's degree in Electrical, Electronics/Communications, or Mechanical Engineering, you may also qualify for entry.

column2: To contact our ICT department, please send an email to ict@iuea.ac.ug describing the nature of your inquiry or come to the ICT department located on the second floor of the main building

column1: Are there any computer labs available for student use?
column2: Yes, IUEA has a computer lab located on the IUEA Main campus next to the main Cafeteria, plot 1112-1121, Kansanga, Ggaba road, Kampala, Uganda. We also have an electronic library that can be accessed by an IUEA student from anywhere. It has all the major databases.

column1: How do I report a problem with campus facilities?
column2: There are online and hard copy forms available to students who wish to report problems with the facilities.

column1: How do I access the campus Wi-Fi?
column2: To access the on-campus Wifi, we kindly request that you see the ICT department located on the second floor/ the Faculty of Business floor.

column1: Where can I get technical support for my laptop?
column2: Technical support for laptops and other devices is available from the on-campus ICT department, which is open from 8 am and 5 pm on Weekdays, and 9 am and 1 pm on Saturdays

column1: My SIS is not working.
column2: Please get in touch with one of our team to be able to help you with that issue. Email: reg@iuea.ac.ug.

column1: Where can I find help for online learning platforms?
column2: Students can get assistance from the Online Systems Manager, Madam Preethima Nataraj at +256 709 994327

column1: How do I print documents on campus?
column2: Students can print documents on campus from the on-campus stationary shop.

column1: SUB-CATEGORY: PARKING AND TRANSPORTATION
Are there bike rental services on campus?
column2: The buildings within the campus are all within easy walking distance.

column1: Is there a shuttle service around campus?
column2: No, the campus is walkable and doesn't require a shuttle service.

column1: Where is the nearest parking to my department?
column2: IUEA has numerous parking lots on campus. There is the main campus lot next to the administration building and the classes for science, technology, business, humanities and law, and there is the Soweto Road parking lot, which is closest to the engineering labs and the smartclassrooms.

column1: SUB-CATEGORY: LIBRARY SERVICES
Is there a campus bookstore?
column2: There are bookstores within walking distance of the campus.

column1: How do I access online library resources?
column2: All Active students are provided a link to the online library resources. Email for more info: lilian.mudoola@iuea.ac.ug

column1: Where is the library, and what are its hours?
column2: The library is located on the IUEA Main campus next to the main Cafeteria, plot 1112-1121, Kansanga, Ggaba road, Kampala, Uganda, next to the student Cafeteria. It is open between the hours of 8 am and 9 pm. The electronic library can also be accessed by an IUEA student from anywhere. It has all the major databases.

column1: SUB-CATEGORY: TEACHING FACILITIES
What modern facilities does IUEA offer?
column2: IUEA has smart classrooms that provide an immersive learning experience. We have advanced laboratories equipped with industry-standard tools. We have the IUEA innovation labs where students can experiment, in addition to campus-wide Wi-Fi. We have one of the largest auditoriums in East Africa.

column1: SUB-CATEGORY: STUDY ROOMS
How can I book a study room?
column2: IUEA has numerous facilities and learning spaces that students can use without booking, however, should the student need a specialised space for studies for example, rooms with projectors, smart boards, etc. they can contact the dean of students office.

column1: SUB-CATEGORY: LOST AND FOUND
Is there a lost and found office?
column2: Yes, at the dean of students office and the reception.

column1: SUB-CATEGORY: SPORTS FACILITIES
What sports facilities are available on campus?
column2: IUEA has one of the largest sports centres in Uganda, with 2 basketball courts, a massive field, a modern astroturf pitch, swimming pools and a netball court.

column1: SUB-CATEGORY: DIRECTORIES
Is there a campus map available online?
column2: Please visit the reception for directions

column1: CATEGORY: HOSTELS
CATEGORY: GENERAL INFORMATION ABOUT IUEA HOSTELS
How do I apply for on-campus housing?
column2: Campus housing application forms are available through the dean of students office.

column1: What are the housing options available?
column2: There are gender-based hostels. There's shared room options and single rental options. Most hostels are within walking distance or a short ride away from campus.

column1: How do I report a maintenance issue in my dorm?
column2: Maintenance issues in hostels are reported to the on-site hostel manager.

column1: SUB-CATEGORY: HOSTEL FEES
How much does it cost to rent a room at the university hostels?
column2:
The cost of renting a room at IUEA hostels varies depending on the number of people sharing the room:
Private single room: $400 per semester.
Room for 2 people: $350 per person per semester.
Room for 3 people: $300 per person per semester.
Room for 4 people: $208 per person per semester.
Room for 6 people: $160 per person per semester.
Room for 8 people: $120 per person per semester.
For more information, you can contact the Hostel Manager, Hamisu, via Call/WhatsApp at +256704911904.

column1: SUB-CATEGORY: BORROWING EQUIPMENT
How do I borrow equipment from the ICT department?
column2: Equipment such as projectors and smart boards can be borrowed from the ICT department by filling out a simple form and showing an IUEA ID.

column1: SUB-CATEGORY: CLUBS AND EXTRA CURRICULAR ACTIVITIES
How do I start a new club or organization?
column2: Students can start a new club or organisation by registering the club or organisation with the dean of students. Requirements for setting up a club or organisation, finding an adviser, creating a constitution and governance structure are available from the Dean of Students office.

column1: Are there any leadership opportunities available?
column2: Yes, there are many leadership opportunites available. IUEA has numerous student professional associations in business, agriculture, innovation, climate change and many other areas where students can gain leadership experience,both on campus and outside.

column1: Are there any cultural or diversity programs?
column2: Yes, there are numerous cultural and diversity programs available. The guild (student union) hosts cultural events where students from about 54 countries participate in competitions, dance, poetry, fashion and food exhibitions/tasting.

column1: How can I register for a self-defense class?
column2: There is a self-defence club. For more info, visit the gym lab

column1: SUB-CATEGORY: WORKSHOPS AND JOB PLACEMENT
Are there any career services or job placement support?
column2: Yes, there are career services or job placement support. IUEA regularly brings on campus orgnaisations that are looking to hire students directly or provide job placement support.

column1: Are there any workshops on using library databases?
column2: Yes, there are workshops on using library databases. The workshops are conducted by the library department and they are conducted frequently.

column1: How can I get involved in student organizations or clubs?
column2: By contacting the guild/student union office and/or the Dean of students office for a list of student organizations and clubs, including requirements for joining or starting a new club.

column1: CATEGORY: STUDY LEAVES & PROBATION
Can I take a leave of absence? If so, how?
column2: To take a leave of absence, kindly send a letter via email to the Dean or Faculty Administrator

column1: What is the policy for academic probation?
column2: The academic probation is guided by exams. The probation is dependent on the severity of the infraction. For clarification, please email academic.registrar@iuea.ac.ug.

column1: How do I change my major?
column2: To change your programme, kindly send an email to our admissions office via the email, apply@iuea.ac.ug or call +256 705 722 300 / +256 790002000

column1: SUB-CATEGORY: TRANSCRIPTS
How can I get a copy of my transcript?
column2: To get a copy of your transcript, kindly contact the Academic Registrar's Office through academic.registrar@iuea.ac.ug

column1: CATEGORY: EXAMINATION
How do I find out about the grading policy?
column2: It is in our study and examination policy, which is available to all students. For more information, send an email to academic.registrar@iuea.ac.ug

column1: Can I retake a class to improve my grade?
column2: Yes, you can, at a fee of 20 USD. Please keep in mind that it will be indicated on your final transcript as a retake. For more information, send an email to academic.registrar@iuea.ac.ug

column1: What are the requirements for honours in my major?
column2: Not applicable to the Ugandan system.

column1: Do you have examination fees?
column2: Except for retakes, there are no additional fees regarding examinations.

column1: SUB-CATEGORY: GRADUATION
How do I apply for graduation?
column2: Guidance on the graduation registration process can be obtained from the office of the academic registrar through academic.registrar@iuea.ac.ug

column1: When is Graduation?
column2: At IUEA, we traditionally hold graduation on the last Thursday of November.

column1: SUB-CATEGORY: PARTIES AND EVENTS
Has Davido come to IUEA?
column2: Davido came to IUEA on the 29th of March, 2024, and launched the IUEA faculty of music and arts.

column1: Has Fally Ipupa come to IUEA?
column2: Fally Ipupa came to IUEA in 2023

column1: Does IUEA hold parties for new students?
column2: Yes, we hold welcoming celebrations for new students, called Fresher's parties, at least twice a year in addition to orientation.

column1: Does IUEA host events that students can participate in?
column2: Yes, we regularly host a variety of events that celebrate our students, support philanthropic causes, and promote academic excellence and awareness. These events often come with special deals, surprises, and plenty of opportunities for students to get involved and make the most of their university experience.

column1: What is the International Youth Festival?
column2: IUEA held the International Youth Festival on the 4th and 5th of October 2024. Day one, which happened on our vibrant campus, was filled with groundbreaking discussions on Africa's future, focusing on Nuclear Energy, Healthcare, and Ecology. It was your chance to gain insider knowledge and get a jumpstart in industries set to transform the continent. Then, on the 5th, attendees joined us at Across the Nile Resort for an unforgettable cultural celebration, organized by our Bachelor of Tourism and Hotel Management.

column1: When is Mr & Miss IUEA?
column2: IUEA typically holds the Mr & Miss beauty pageant in November. For more information reach out to the marketing department

column1: What is Mr & Miss IUEA?
column2: Mr. & Miss IUEA is an exciting beauty pageant that celebrates the talent, creativity, and charisma of IUEA students. Participants compete to earn the prestigious title of becoming the face of the university, embodying its spirit and values.

Does IUEA offer the Higher Education Certificate Programme?
column2: The Higher Education Certificate Programme has been officially renamed to the Higher Education Access Programme

column1: Does IUEA offer the International Foundation Programme?
column2: The International Foundation Programme has been officially renamed to the Higher Education Access Programme
